a

concepts.definition: FOUNDATIONS is a Tier 1 member owning standing vocabulary; ontology and imports; commitments P0–P6, foundation-to-law format and material-family index; composition, conservation, core results, conjunction and categorical demonstration requirements; and hypotheses. Other members import or refine these definitions.

grounding.quote:
Other members import these definitions
([Imports between members](#imports-between-members)) or refine them.

concepts.label: FOUNDATIONS member

concepts.definition: Foundational standing grounds a commitment or hypothesis relative to other foundational claims. Exactly four standings are defined: recovered, an adopted premise consolidating named source rules without treating them as proof; independent, an adopted premise argued by a case where other commitments hold and it fails; derived, a consequence naming its premises; hypothesis, a claim established by neither method clause nor argument, held for falsification and not law. This differs from result standing and a successor's disposition of a predecessor claim.

grounding.quote: Each has exactly one of four standings:

concepts.label: Foundational standing

concepts.definition: Four distinct meanings of join are named: categorical join is a map between categories; composition boundary joins successive steps; join of results combines closed results under one decision rule; relation join is equality joining participants in an enclosing relation. An unqualified join in a result context means join of results.

grounding.quote: Four uses of "join" in this corpus are distinct

concepts.label: Four meanings of join

concepts.definition: A Subject is the exact thing a claim, representation or transformation concerns, with inventory and bytes or semantic addresses. A Representation is bytes, text, model or program standing for it; equal representations do not establish equal meaning. An Interpretation declares the representation-to-meaning contract within a Context, including reliable distinctions and residuals. Context declares subject, definitions, basis and admissible observations.

grounding.quote: | Interpretation | a declared contract from representation to meaning within a context; says which distinctions a consumer may rely on and which are residual | P1 |

concepts.label: Subject, representation, interpretation and context

concepts.definition: Outcome U is a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval against which transformation adequacy is judged. Object O is a subject with scoped identity (authority, kind, value), boundary, current state and declared material relations; its identity survives admissible state and encoding changes.

grounding.quote: | Outcome U | a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval; adequacy of a transformation is judged against it | P2 |

concepts.label: Outcome and object

concepts.definition: An Actor performs a step within a declared context, attention, time and capability envelope. A role is a relation the actor occupies, with available roles determined by configuration. A Step is bounded work comprising intake, selected context, grant, execution and output. A Step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision that cannot be reacquired from declared sources; reproducible observations are excluded.

grounding.quote: | Step-produced fact | a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable and is not one | P0, P4b |

concepts.label: Actor, step and step-produced fact

concepts.definition: A Claim asserts a property of a subject with basis, witness relation and falsifier. Evidence consists of exact admitted observations or artifacts, each carrying provenance, subject identity, basis and scope; availability in a frame supplies neither semantic truth nor decision authority. A Judgment records evaluation of an unchanged subject, evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation. Authority is identity-bearing permission to operate or dispose acceptance within scope. Residual is material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation retained until authorised disposition.

grounding.quote: | Judgment | a recorded evaluation over an unchanged subject, with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation | P6 |

concepts.label: Claim, evidence, judgment, authority and residual

concepts.definition: Basis is the exact state bound by a step, claim, result or evaluation, including every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration or evidence coordinate whose change can alter it. It is immutable or moving with declared advancement detection and reevaluation conditions; mixed bases require an explicit composite relation. Materiality is evaluation-relative: lawful change can change the result, invalidate basis, change admissible evidence, change who may perform a material operation, or change who may decide the evaluation or a material operation. The same test applies to uncertainty or closure; materiality in one frame need not hold in another.

grounding.quote: mixed bases need an explicit composite relation

concepts.label: Basis and materiality

concepts.definition: Evaluation is a declared question with known admissible result family, evidence basis and decision authority, plus operation authority where it performs material action. Questions may concern judgment, prediction, construction, comparison, proof, refusal, classification or action recommendation. An Evaluation family requires the same material-relation manifold, authority basis and result algebra; similar wording does not establish family identity.

grounding.quote: similar wording does not prove that two evaluations share a family

concepts.label: Evaluation and evaluation family

concepts.definition: Workspace is the bounded material reasoned over or acted upon, potentially including constitutional sources, assets, designs, implementations, tools, runtime state, evidence, history, external dependencies and human decisions; a repository is one possible carrier. A Material-relation manifold is the finite, jointly interpretable variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities, observations and exclusions needed by an evaluation family. Its charts may overlap; no geometric mathematics or runtime abstraction is implied.

grounding.quote: no geometric mathematics or runtime abstraction is implied

concepts.label: Workspace and material-relation manifold

concepts.definition: Coordinate is the complete local position for interpreting a value, event, decision, observation or action, including required basis, identity, lineage, input, evidence and authority. Equality follows a declared relation, not equal names, values, shapes, locations or apparent topology positions. Topology is the material entities, capabilities, authorities, lifecycle state spaces, adjacencies and seams visible to a frame at one basis; it need not be the whole workspace topology. State-value change preserves topology only if every such constituent is preserved; changing any is a topology mutation that may invalidate coordinates.

grounding.quote: a frame need not hold the workspace's complete topology

concepts.label: Coordinate and topology

concepts.definition: Capability envelope is the competence, context capacity, tools, access, applicable evaluation or assurance independence conditions, and configuration needed to activate and evaluate a frame. The same frame can be usable by one actor and unusable by another. Capability can justify different frame size or activation sequence, but cannot waive invariants or widen authority.

grounding.quote: actor capability may justify a different frame size or activation sequence and can neither waive an invariant nor widen authority

concepts.label: Capability envelope

concepts.definition: Reference frame is a finite specification of attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations for one declared evaluation family over a stated basis. Activated frame binds one declaration to exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary; declaration reuse does not prove activation correctness. These objects are defined in FOUNDATIONS, with laws assigned to REFERENCE_FRAME and activating steps to ACTIVATION.

grounding.quote: a reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct

concepts.label: Reference frame and activated frame

concepts.definition: Frame set is a human-declared family available for a governed outcome or workspace. Active frame configuration is the activations and declared result relations used for one evaluation or decision, potentially one frame or several disjoint, overlapping or composed frames. Lens is a reusable question family; abstract authority, capability and reuse, temporal behaviour, transport and proof may be lenses. A lens becomes a frame only with bounded evaluation, basis, manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra and capability envelope. Role allocates responsibility or admitted authority; persona changes approach or salience; abstraction hides or contracts detail; component is a structural part. None is a reference frame by identity alone.

grounding.quote: a lens becomes a frame only when instantiated with a bounded evaluation, basis, material manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra and capability envelope

concepts.label: Frame sets, configurations, lenses and related roles

concepts.definition: Authority kinds are frame-set authority (human declaration or acceptance of a project frame set), semantic authority (meaning owner), evaluation authority (role permitted to evaluate), operation authority (owner-issued grant to construct, transform, admit, publish or mutate a material subject), and decision authority (role permitted to accept, reject or otherwise dispose a result). Actor identity names the performer and is not authority. Kinds may coincide lawfully but never collapse by default.

grounding.quote:
These may coincide in a lawful case and
never collapse by default.

concepts.label: Authority kinds

concepts.definition: Frame disjointness is structural absence of shared material variables, coordinates, evidence or result dependencies for declared evaluations. Evaluation independence is procedural separation: separately activated evaluations neither consume nor influence one another's unclosed working results, though subjects and manifolds may overlap and closed results may later enter one conjunction. Assurance independence is claim-relative, determined by governing assurance law's non-authorship, acquisition, exposure, actor and configuration separation conditions.

grounding.quote: Three relations stay distinct

concepts.label: Three distinct separation relations

concepts.definition: The frame tuple is ⟨Q, B, M, C, I, A, E, X, R, J, K, D⟩: evaluation family; workspace/topology basis; manifold; coordinate/equality law; applicable invariants; authority relation; admissible evidence/provenance law; exclusions/prohibited assumptions; closed result algebra or core-mapped refinement; invalidation/rechart condition; capability envelope; optional declared dependencies, overlaps, inputs and outputs involving other frames. It specifies an evaluation contract, not a mandatory schema or runtime carrier.

grounding.quote:
The tuple specifies the relation; it is not a required schema or runtime
carrier

concepts.label: Frame tuple

concepts.definition: The recursive-product taxonomy, owned here under urn:stdo:bounded-context:recursive-product-taxonomy, retains concept identities under urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:. Substrate is a lower product/runtime for building products. Development product is the role of one exact released-product install as builder substrate for a source project; it creates no new product identity or transfer of meaning or authority. Source project is the mutable workspace building the next release cut. Artifact is any published output built by a source project or configured installed product.

grounding.quote: the role creates no new product identity and transfers no meaning or authority from the builder to the product being authored

concepts.label: Substrate, development product, source project and artifact

concepts.definition: Release cut is one immutable annotated release-candidate boundary over a published feature set. Product is the released immutable thing resulting when that cut is accepted. Install is a stamped workspace instance of that Product. Product definition is the present-tense source-project authority surface, conventionally PRODUCT.md, defining current WHAT for decomposition; it is not the released artifact. Their carried concept identities use the recursive-product-taxonomy namespace with release-cut, product, install and product-definition suffixes.

grounding.quote: | Product (`urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:product`) | the released immutable thing resulting when that release cut is accepted | P3 |

concepts.label: Release cut, Product, install and Product definition

concepts.definition: A candidate source is mutable source-project state constructing a possible successor and is non-operative for released consumers. A release subject is the exact declared member set or artifact bound by a cut and described by release-scoped claims; co-location in a carrier creates no membership. A version-line selector is a mutable alias for the highest-ordinal published cut on one project's version line, useful for discovery but neither immutable identity nor sufficient exact basis. These remain distinct from each other and from the cut despite equal version text.

grounding.quote:
A selector or a
mutable carrier may move; a release cut never moves.

concepts.label: Candidate source, release subject and version-line selector

concepts.definition: The work-boundary object surrounds a probabilistic, agentic or delegated unit. Its six parts are input/output contract, required context, capability or role expectation, admissible evidence/evaluator regime, provenance obligation, and lawful stop/hold/gap/continuation/completion states. Live specification and design should declare them. ACTIVATION §1's step makes this unit's intake, context and result algebra exact.

grounding.quote:
The declared boundary of such a unit is an object with six parts, which the
live specification and design should declare

concepts.label: Work boundary

concepts.definition: Construction realises a selected outer contract through steps. Its algorithmic description is the steps; informational interpretation is data meaning under an Interpretation; computational realisation is performance by people, machines or combinations in a declared execution environment, with build-tenant environment referred to SPEC_METHOD §11. The three-account distinction applies to any construction, is independent of tiers, and is an added choice owned by the corpus-owning Product's Intent in its Direction; it is not a commitment and has no foundational standing.

grounding.quote:
a construction may need all three accounts, and no
account is a tier

concepts.label: Three accounts of a construction

concepts.definition: Semantic import is reference-only adoption of a cited meaning unchanged. Source and target are identical owner-qualified references; direction runs from named source to importing context, with no loss, translation or ownership transfer and no authority supplied. Adoption means taking the imported concept into use under its source-owned adoption premises; lifecycle remains source-owned.

grounding.quote:
An import is
reference-only.

concepts.label: Semantic import and adoption

concepts.definition: An import's source context is the bounded context declared by the owning member, or that member if none is declared. The owning section is a textual locus rather than semantic authority.

grounding.quote:
the source context: the bounded context the owning member declares, or
  that member itself where it declares none;

concepts.label: Import source context

concepts.definition: An import's target is the importing context and the member owning it; for a point-of-use reference it is the using member's context.

grounding.quote: its target is the using member's context

concepts.label: Import target context

concepts.definition: P0 Bounded construction is recovered: a finite actor realises an outer contract through steps whose selected contexts fit its envelope; internal paths remain its own. Its premises include selected outcome, possibly different successive actors, reacquirable declared sources but not private memory, non-reacquirable step-produced facts, an open world, and outputs remaining candidates until evaluated. Its named sources are RF-002, RF-003, AC-010, the work boundary and outer-contract refinement, not proofs.

grounding.quote:
step-produced facts are not re-acquirable; the world is open; a
step's output is a candidate until evaluated.

concepts.label: P0 Bounded construction

concepts.definition: P1 Interpretation is independent: subject, representation and interpretation remain distinct; meaning requires a declared context and contract; structural success never establishes fidelity. Its non-entailment example keeps the other commitments while an undeclared second contract reads feet as metres. Algorithmic means explicit and structurally checkable; semantic decisions require exact decision contracts. Claimed conservation sources are AC-017, AC-018, AC-019 and RF-008.

grounding.quote:
a semantic decision is lawful only
under an exact decision contract.

concepts.label: P1 Interpretation

concepts.definition: P2 Purpose is independent: the selected outcome defines adequacy and interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation served; an obligation without a route to the outcome is unjustified. The non-entailment example fixes obligations by available capacity rather than transformation, allowing the same obligations for opposite outcomes despite the other commitments. Claimed conservation sources are UP-013, UP-014 and UP-005.

grounding.quote:
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit
material obligations from the transformation they serve.

concepts.label: P2 Purpose

concepts.definition: P3 Identity is independent: identity declares authority, kind and value and survives admissible change; boundaries are claims with proof obligations. Current state, historical observations and representation identity remain separate. Its non-entailment example derives identity only from storage place, making an admissible move split one object into two while other commitments hold. Claimed sources include AC-002, AC-014, recursive Product taxonomy and Entity Cut Construction Law.

grounding.quote:
An object's identity is declared (authority, kind, value) and
survives admissible change; a boundary is a claim with a proof obligation.

concepts.label: P3 Identity

concepts.definition: P4a Typed composition is independent: composition requires the first result type and judgment to satisfy the second step's exact domain and preconditions, while retaining both identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states. Its non-entailment example runs the second step on every output, returning invalid_basis outside domain and retaining only outer-contract facts; other commitments hold but compatibility and intermediate retention fail. Retention supports locating repair or restart. Claimed sources are AC-016 and RF-010.

grounding.quote:
Two steps compose only when the first's result type
and judgment satisfy the second's exact declared domain and preconditions.

concepts.label: P4a Typed composition

concepts.definition: P4b Conservation of step-produced facts is derived from P0 and P2, specifically non-reacquirability under P0 and outer-contract need under P2. Producing steps record needed judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions; later actors can reacquire sources, not private results. Reacquirable sources instead fall under sufficiency. The source reframes AC-009, AC-013, AC-005, UP-017 and UP-021's nine conservation statements into one obligation with typed authority, residual, judgment, frame, transition, successor-claim and evidence-by-reference instances.

grounding.quote:
Judgments, residuals, observations
and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step
that produced them.

concepts.label: P4b Conservation of step-produced facts

concepts.definition: P5 Totality is derived from P0's open-world premise and P6: a step may encounter a condition outside context and cannot report success on it, so its result algebra has first-class other-than-success outcomes and its control model names the next move. The particular three outcomes indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis are a declared choice owned by Results, conserved from RF-012, rather than entailed by the derivation. Further cited sources are RF-014, AC-007 and the Totality Rule.

grounding.quote:
That these
outcomes are three, indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis, is a
declared choice

concepts.label: P5 Totality

concepts.definition: P6 Justification and authority is independent: definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have different standing; evidence supports claims on a basis, while authority permits or disposes within scope. Neither creates the other. A bounded actor taking a green label as acceptance is the non-entailment example. Claimed sources include UP-001, UP-008, UP-022, UP-004, RF-006 and RF-007.

grounding.quote:
evidence
supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.

concepts.label: P6 Justification and authority

concepts.definition: Construction synthesis is a derived consequence, not another commitment, relating the commitments to movement from observed current state to acceptable destination under finite resources. P0 bounds acquisition/work and preserves internal paths; P1 separates required conditions, observations and predictions while preserving comparison meaning; P2 selects destination Z and adequacy criteria; P3 separates persistent subject/current observations/dependencies from accounts; P4a carries obligations through refinement and boundaries; P4b conserves non-reacquirable facts through observation/correction/reuse; P5 accounts for tradeoffs, recursive progress, recovery and truthful undecided stops; P6 establishes support and authority to change models, act or accept. ACTIVATION §1 owns the construction relation.

grounding.quote:
It is derived, not a further
commitment

concepts.label: Construction synthesis

concepts.definition: A deciding-rule family groups related rules deciding outcomes; it is material when those outcomes matter to the method's selected outcome. A family table is a trace located at the owning member's entry section, preceded by labelled instance premises and containing one row per consequence. Its five columns are premises with standing, consequence, owning rule, added choice with owner, and Pillar. The table owns no rules or choices and decides nothing beyond the named rules.

grounding.quote:
A family table is a trace. Its consequence and choice columns state no
determination that the rule it names does not state, and the table owns
none of the rules or choices it lists

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law family table

concepts.definition: Pillars trace the corpus-owning Product's ten Foundational Reduction contributions, in order: specification/project structure; world models/identity/Markov objects; algebraic calculus; functional design; outcome-driven development; information/interpretation; reference frames; computational calculus/execution binding; evidence/correction/authority; axiomatic calculus. The Product owns their wording. Pillar cells are neither premises, standing, choice owners, axioms nor deductions from finite capacity.

grounding.quote:
A Pillar cell is a trace, like the rest of the table: it is not
  a premise, adds no standing to the row, owns no choice

concepts.label: Pillar trace

concepts.definition: Algebra describes typed composition s₂ ∘ s₁ for s₁: X → Y and s₂: Y → Z, conservation accounting, reference-versus-body sufficiency, explicit latitude and shared computational machinery. Composition exists only under P4a, carries both steps' facts and uses the referenced conjunction law for its result. The referenced RF-010 decides when composition law is needed versus independent evaluations returning closed results to one conjunction or decision rule.

grounding.quote: Composition. For steps s₁: X → Y and s₂: Y → Z, s₂ ∘ s₁ exists only under P4a.

concepts.definition: The formal fragment specifies evidence needed for categorical claims about the method or constructions. A category declares objects, arrows, arrow equality, identity arrows and associative unital composition. A map declares object and arrow mappings and is called a functor only after identity and composition preservation are proved. This requirement itself asserts no categorical functor.

grounding.quote:
called a functor only after its preservation of identities and
  composition is proved

evidence and the whole claim is unresolved

constraints.statement: Existing project authority selects/projects configuration. A known incapable or unauthorised actor yields activation refusal and no Worker result. A fresh capable Worker reconstructs intake without hidden history. Every effectful activation binds exact inherited grant, subject and write territory: in-territory mutation succeeds only under grant, out-of-territory mutation refuses, and no authority is granted to another frame. Every work-result value is cause-selected, maps to exactly one ACTIVATION §3 core value and returns to its declared consumer, Executive in the coordinated branch. A sufficient direct local case starts/finishes as Writer in its existing carrier without Executive appointment or independent review; coordinated candidate_ready also reaches disposition without Reviewer activation when review is not required. When review is required, Executive, not Worker, activates Reviewer. Reviewer reacquires exact subject and material live production/assurance surfaces. Candidate or basis change invalidates affected review. Worker self-review, Reviewer evaluation, Executive decision authority and disposition stay distinct. Missing-frame pressure triggers bounded diagnosis or lawful re-entry.

Domain instances cite this common list and add only the instance.
